gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO FOR AFTER EFFECTS - WETIN NYU
Vashɔn 9.2.8  -  Oktoba 2026
================================================================================

Di panel nau de tɔk 132 LANGWEJ, dɛn dɔn ad nyu DEMON SLAYER TIM DƐN we gɛt wan
sɔd we de kɔt di batɔn dɛn we yu prɛs, ɛn sɔm layout ɛn Windows fiks dɛn.

BIFO YU START
- Instɔl am pantap yu kɔrɛnt vashɔn wit yu yuzhual ZXP instɔla, dɔn ristat
  After Effects wan tɛm.
- Yu setin dɛn, tim, preset dɛn ɛn di expression dɛn we yu sev go stil de.

NYU: DI PANEL IN 132 LANGWEJ
- Flex Setin dɛn > LANGWEJ nau lɛt 132 langwej, wit sach bɔks. Pik wan
  ɛn di wan panel go chenj: tab dɛn, batɔn dɛn, tultip dɛn, mɛsej dɛn.
- AI bin transleyt ɔl di langwej dɛn frɔm di Inglish panel, nɔto wɔd bay wɔd. Di nem dɛn
  we yu si na yu prɔjɛkt (layer nem dɛn, ɛfɛkt nem dɛn) go stil de na Inglish
  so dat dɛn go stil mach After Effects.
- Di "wetin nyu" popup dɔn transleyt tu, frɔm dis rilis go.

NYU: DEMON SLAYER TIM DƐN
- Flex Setin dɛn > TIM SELƐKTA gɛt wan nyu DEMON SLAYER grup wit 11 tim:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen ɛn Kokushibo.
- Muv di maus oba di panel ɛn di tim in ɛlimɛnt go fala am: wata,
  faya, layning, bɔtafla, flawa pɛtal, fɔg ɛn mɔ. Wɛn di maus
  stɔp, i go fed awe.
- Klik wan batɔn ɛn da kɔrɛkta in sɔd go kɔt am. If yu kip di lɛft batɔn
  prɛs, i go kɔntinyu fɔ kɔt am; if yu ol am lɛk 2.5 sɛkɔn, i go bɔs.
- Dɛn mek am fɔ nɔ ebi: di ɛfɛkt dɛn de wok onli wɛn yu de muv ɔ klik, ɛn
  dɛn go mek dɛnsɛf nɔ ebi pan slo kɔmpyuta dɛn. Ɔf AMBIENT EFFECT DƐN
  na di TIM SELƐKTA fɔ kip onli di kɔlɔ dɛn.

CHENJ: FLAT BATƆN DƐN NA ƐVRI TIM
- Di aktiv ɛn mɛn batɔn dɛn na di kɔlɔ tim dɛn nɔ de yuz shedid gradient
  frɔm tɔp go na butɔm igen. Dɛn na wan flat kɔlɔ wit sɔft glow, so dɛn
  luk klina ɛn dɛn izi fɔ rid.

DƐN DƆN FIKS
- Di laysɛns kad ɛn di "wetin nyu" popup bin kin opin pantap ɔda.
  Nau dɛn nɔ go ɛva opin pantap ɔda igen, ɛn di APDET badj nɔ de kɔba di
  batɔn dɛn na di tɔp na di panel igen.
- Na UI SKEL 125% ɛn 150%, sɔm windo dɛn (lɛk Flex Setin dɛn) bin kin grow
  mɔ tɔl pas di panel, so dɛn klos batɔn bin go na say we yu nɔ go si am. Ɛvri windo
  nau fit na ɛvri saiz.
- Windows: AutoCaptions bin kin se "DI NVIDIA DRAIVA OL TU MƆCH FƆ GPU
  CAPTION DƐN" pan nyu kad ɛn draiva dɛn (RTX 40 ɛn 50 siriz). Nau i de rid
  di draiva in CUDA sɔpɔt rayt ɛn yuz yu GPU.

NƆ CHENJ
- Laysɛns, aktiveshɔn ɛn ɛvri link de wok jɔs lɛk bifo.
- Ɛvri ɔda tab ɛn tul de wok jɔs lɛk na 9.2.7.
================================================================================

ult.message:
FLEX ULTIMATE FOR PREMIERE PRO - WETIN NYU
Vashɔn 2.2.8  -  Oktoba 2026

CAPTION STACK kapshɔn dɛn nau na Motion Graphics tɛmplet dɛn we yu kin ɛdit, wit wan rial
ɛditɔ, wan nyu AUDIO STUDIO ɛn MAK AUDIO BIT DƐN de, di panel de tɔk 132
LANGWEJ, UI SKEL kam na ULTIMATE, ɛn nyu DEMON SLAYER TIM DƐN de.

BIFO YU START
- Instɔl am pantap yu kɔrɛnt vashɔn wit yu yuzhual ZXP instɔla, dɔn ristat
  Premiere Pro wan tɛm.
- Yu setin dɛn, tim ɛn preset dɛn go stil de.

NYU: CAPTION STACK - KAPSHƆN DƐN WE YU KIN ƐDIT (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Dɛn de put kapshɔn dɛn nau az Motion Graphics tɛmplet dɛn we yu kin ɛdit (Output >
  EDITABLE MOGRT, di nyu difɔlt na Premiere Pro 2026). Afta yu put am,
  chenj ɛni wɔd, fɔnt, kɔlɔ, saiz, pozishɔn, glow, outlayn, bɔks,
  animéshɔn ɔ taym na Premiere in Essential Graphics panel.
- Output > IMEJ DƐN stil put ɛvri wɔd az wan pikchɔ wit di sem luk,
  if na dat yu want.
- Di tɛmplet dɛn kam wit di panel. Nɔ gɛt natin fɔ dawnlod.

NYU: CAPTION STACK ƐDITƆ
- Di priviu nau de sho di rial frem frɔm yu vidio ɔnda ɛni kapshɔn.
- Drag wan kapshɔn fɔ muv am, yuz di kɔna fɔ risaiz am ɛn di tɔp dɔt fɔ
  rotet am, dɔbul-klik wan wɔd fɔ ɛdit am. WHOLE CAPTION de muv ɔl di wɔd dɛn
  togɛda, ONE WORD de muv jɔs wan wɔd.
- Pik if wan chenj go apply to ɔl kapshɔn dɛn ɔ jɔs dis kapshɔn, ɛn
  sev yu layout dɛn fɔ yuz dɛn igen.
- 10 nyu GLOW luk dɛn: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow ɛn Superb.

NYU: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Pik wan audio klip, pik wan ɛfɛkt ɛn prɛs YUZ. Ɛvritin de rɔn
  na yu kɔmpyuta.
- 30 wan-klik preset dɛn: Ɔnda Wata, Bass Boost, Rum / Hɔl / Katidral /
  Plate riverb, Eko, Telifon, Redio, Mɛgafon, Robɔt, Chipmunk, Dip
  Vɔys, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Rivɛs ɛn mɔ. Stak
  as bɔku ɛfɛkt as yu want, riɔda dɛn ɔ ɔf wan.
- Riverb kip in tel: di saund de kɔntinyu pas di ɛnd na di klip, ɛn dɛn put am
  so dat natin na yu timelayn nɔ go rayt oba.
- Tul dɛn: Noyz Rimuva, Vɔys Inhans, Laudnɛs (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Hum Rimuva, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Spid
  ɛn Pich, Noise Gate, Ɛkstrakt Audio.
- STEMS MAKER de pat wan sɔng ɔt na vɔys ɛn myuzik (ɔ 4 stem). I de dawnlod
  in model di fɔs tɛm ɛn i de aks yu fɔs.
- PRIVIU lɛ yu yɛri lɛk 8 sɛkɔn wit wan Orijinal / Dɔn prosɛs switch.
  Di rizɔt de go na wan frii audio trak ɛn yu orijinal klip de mut,
  i nɔ de dilit ɛva.

NYU: MAK AUDIO BIT DƐN (FX & ADV RIGS > MAK AUDIO BIT DƐN)
- Pik wan myuzik klip na di timelayn ɛn prɛs MAK BIT DƐN: Flex go
  fɛn di bit dɛn ɛn ad sikwɛns maka dɛn pan dɛm, so dat yu kɔt dɛn go fit
  rayt wit di myuzik.
- Pik ɔl hit dɛn, KIK DƐN ɔ SNEYA DƐN, sɛt di sɛnsitiviti, ɛn mak ɛvri bit ɔ
  ɛvri 2nd ɔ 4th bit.
- RIMUV BIT MAKA DƐN de klin jɔs di maka dɛn we Flex ad. I de rɔn
  na yu kɔmpyuta.

NYU: DI PANEL IN 132 LANGWEJ
- Setin dɛn > LANGWEJ nau lɛt 132 langwej, wit sach bɔks. Tab dɛn,
  batɔn dɛn, tultip dɛn ɛn mɛsej dɛn ɔl de chenj. Di "wetin nyu" popup dɔn
  transleyt tu, frɔm dis rilis go.

NYU: UI SKEL
